# peakAge

> Hierarchical Bayesian Joint Modeling of Athlete performance trajectories and Latent Peak Ages

`peakAge` is an R package for modeling athlete performance trajectories
and estimating latent peak age using parametric and semi-parametric performance curves.
The package currently supports symmetric and asymmetric parametric forms
and is under active development.

## Status

🚧 **Under active development**  
The API may change. Feedback is welcome.
